title: No Hispanic students enrolled at Lake Pleasant School for 2025-26
text:
Lake Pleasant School had no Hispanic students enrolled for the 2025-26 school year, reflecting no change from the prior year, according to the New York State Education Department .
The school reported a total enrollment of 65 students during this time. Hispanic students accounted for 0% of the population, marking them as the least represented ethnic group at Lake Pleasant School.
Lake Pleasant School operates within the Lake Pleasant Central School District, which maintains its main office in Speculator.
It was also the only school in the district recording Hispanic student enrollment, though no Hispanic students attended during this period.
An analysis by World Population Review notes that New York’s public schools ranked second nationwide overall , but came in 31st for K-12 performance.
